title: 第156章 换古魔心脏第155章 本尊有办法
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
第一卷第156章换古魔心脏
几个长老听见洛还真一副打包票的语气，心里依旧有点犹豫。
他们还是很担心老四出意外的。
虽然对宗主是应该尊重和听信。
但他们四个老东西朝夕相处，相依为命，死一个就少一个。
他们真的害怕。
但是由不得他们考虑了，因为，洛大海自己开口了。
“我要试试！”
他选择相信洛还真。
毕竟她不止以一个元婴期境界，搞死了死对头混元宗的一个合体期长老，她还靠着自己找到了他们一叶宗的藏宗之地。
所以，心里不由得抱了些许的期翼：
万一呢。
万一她还真的有能力呢？
洛大海想得很开。
自己的寿元虽然还久，但其他几个老哥的寿命都快要尽了，他就算在洛还真的手下嘎了。
那黄泉路上倒还能和他们几个作伴了！
也不失为一件好事。
既然洛大海都已经选择了，其他几位一叶宗的长老，再也没有了反对的理由。
于是三个人，一人引路带洛还真去一叶宗负责疗愈的医疗殿，两人抬起洛大海的藤椅，跟在洛还真的身后，朝医疗殿的方向去了。
抵达了医疗殿。

柳一和王晋选择离开。
医修治病救人的时候，他们在外面护法就行了。
现在一叶宗重新现世，万一有什么贼人来这里，打扰了老四的治疗就不好了。
而赵白枭则留了下来。
他端坐在洛大海的身旁，闭着眼睛，嘿嘿笑道：“宗主，我老赵给你打下手哈。”
洛还真一双黑白分明的大眼睛，盯着赵白枭。
赵白枭：“……”
虽然他是个瞎子，但是他有五感，他感受得到洛还真对她的无语。
赵白枭叹了口气。
好吧，他也不装了。
他就是担心洛还真给老四治疗的过程中出了什么岔子。
他一直留在这里，好补救来着。
赵白枭道：“那啥，不是老赵不相信宗主，只是多一层保险，对不对？”
对于赵白枭的这个解释，洛还真不置可否。
不过她能理解，毕竟如果躺在这里的人换成是云爻师尊和一个陌生的医修。
哪怕那个医修已经是准仙水平，她也还是会寸步不离的守着的。
洛还真从自己的乾坤袋里取出医修的医疗匣子，小脸严肃地道。
“那就开始手术吧，本尊去给四长老找一个合适的心脏！”
赵白枭觉得真神了。
十年未接触外界，现在的医修，都能随身携带健康心脏了吗？

而且还是合体期的健康心脏。
他有点激动，等着洛还真拿出来。
但是，洛还真没有直接拿出来，而是很突然地扭头问赵白枭：“你要与本尊一起去找吗？”
赵白枭久久没能找回自己的声音。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 156: Replacing the Heart of the Ancient Demon
When several elders heard Luo Huanzhen's confident tone, they still felt a little hesitant.
They were still worried about the fourth child having an accident.
Although one should respect and obey the sect leader.
But the four of them live together day and night and rely on each other for life. If one of them dies, the other will be missing.
They are really scared.
But they had no choice but to think about it, because Luo Dahai spoke on his own.
"I want to try!"
He chose to believe Luo Huanzhen.
After all, she not only killed a combined-stage elder of her rival Hunyuan Sect with her Nascent Soul stage, but she also found the hiding place of their One Leaf Sect on her own.
Therefore, I couldn’t help but hold some hopes in my heart:
What if.
What if she is really capable?
Luo Dahai thinks very broadly.
Although he still has a long lifespan, the lifespans of several other brothers are about to end, and he will be dead even under Luo Huanzhen's hands.
Then I can keep some of them company on the road to Huangquan!
That's not a bad thing.
Now that Luo Dahai has made his choice, the other Yiye Sect elders no longer have any reason to oppose.
So among the three people, one of them led Luo Huanzhen to the medical hall where Yiye Sect was responsible for healing. The two of them lifted Luo Dahai's wicker chair and followed Luo Huanzhen towards the direction of the medical hall.
Arrive at the Medical Hall.
Liu Yi and Wang Jin chose to leave.
When doctors are treating illnesses and saving people, they just need to be outside to protect the Dharma.
Now that Yiye Zong has reappeared, it would be bad if some thieves came here and disturbed the treatment of the fourth child.
Zhao Baixiao stayed.
He sat next to Luo Dahai, closed his eyes, and said with a smile: "Sect Master, I, Lao Zhao, will help you."
Luo Huanzhen stared at Zhao Baixiao with his big black and white eyes.
Zhao Baixiao: "..."
Although he is blind, he has five senses, and he can feel Luo Huanzhen's speechlessness towards her.
Zhao Baixiao sighed.
Well, he doesn’t pretend anymore.
He was just worried that something would go wrong while Luo Huanzhen was treating Lao Si.
He has stayed here to make amends.
Zhao Baixiao said: "Well, it's not that Old Zhao doesn't believe in the sect master, it's just an extra layer of insurance, right?"
Regarding Zhao Baixiao's explanation, Luo was really unconvinced.
But she could understand, after all, if the people lying here were Master Yunyao and a strange medical practitioner.
Even if that medical practitioner is already at the quasi-immortal level, she will still guard him every step of the way.
Luo Huanzhen took out the doctor's medical box from his Qiankun bag and said seriously with a small face.
"Then let's start the operation. I'll find a suitable heart for the Fourth Elder!"
Zhao Baixiao felt really amazing.
After ten years of no contact with the outside world, can current medical practitioners carry a healthy heart with them everywhere?
Moreover, it is a healthy heart in the combined stage.
He was a little excited, waiting for Luo to actually take it out.
However, Luo didn't take it out directly. Instead, he suddenly turned around and asked Zhao Baixiao: "Do you want to go look for it with me?"
Zhao Baixiao couldn't find his voice for a long time.
